messages.subject: Re: [brms-users] LOESS
parts: Thanks - I do find that when I use s() in mgcv vs lo() in GAM there are some differences in prediction, errors, and for 2d smooths the shape is different. Some of my collaborators prefer loess to spline smoothers, I think in part because it's a bit easier to pick the span for less than the parameters of splines. So if there were a way it would be interesting to compare lo() to s() using a Bayesian estimation, as well as comparing lo() in a Bayesian GAM to the estimation method used in the GAM package.
